caption:
An Indian defence company just won a Rs 1,076 crore order from overseas clients. To be delivered over the next three years.

Solar Industries India and its subsidiary secured export orders worth Rs 1,076 crore for defence products, disclosed via a stock exchange filing in May 2026. This is the third major defence export win within roughly six months - following a Rs 1,400 crore order in November 2025 and an Rs 830 crore order in January 2026.

One large export order could be a lucky break. Three in six months from the same company is a pattern of sustained overseas demand.

Sources: NSE filing, HDFC Sky (2026)
